finding: Own local C ELF contains explicit alternate dynamic-division paths in main lambda instantiations, including cold unsigned-char path. This is consistent with profile-sensitive code generation; hot predecessor branches and their execution counts have not been measured. Matching training worker count to runtime is an untested build hypothesis, not an established cause of C6/C8 slowdowns.
